afterSql:

afterSql:

beforeSql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS avg_order_amount
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 100;
afterSql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       ROUND(AVG(order_totals.order_amount), 2) AS avg_order_amount
FROM (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS order_amount
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
) AS order_totals
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = order_totals.order_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 1000;

beforeSql:

FROM members
WHERE last_login_date > (SELECT MAX(last_login_date) FROM members) - INTERVAL '30 days'
  AND last_login_date <= (SELECT MAX(last_login_date) FROM members);

SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
afterSql:
SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.customer_unique_id
LIMIT 10;

beforeSql:

afterSql:

beforeSql:
SELECT r.macro_region, SUM(w.capacity) AS total_capacity
FROM warehouses w
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code
GROUP BY r.macro_region
LIMIT 100;
afterSql:
SELECT r.macro_region, COALESCE(SUM(w.capacity), 0) AS total_capacity
FROM regions r
LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.region_code = r.region_code
GROUP BY r.macro_region
ORDER BY r.macro_region
LIMIT 100;

-- 按州统计：总消费金额 / 该州下单客户身份去重数 = 人均消费
SELECT
  c.customer_state,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id), 2) AS avg_customer_spend
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY avg_customer_spend DESC
LIMIT 100;

beforeSql:
SELECT ml.level_name, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(oi.price), 0), 2) AS sales_amount
FROM member_levels ml
LEFT JOIN members m ON m.level_id = ml.level_id
LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_unique_id = m.customer_unique_id
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY ml.level_id, ml.level_name
ORDER BY sales_amount DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.customer_state, ml.level_name, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count
FROM support_tickets st
JOIN ticket_categories tc ON tc.category_id = st.category_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = st.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN members m ON m.member_id = st.member_id
JOIN member_levels ml ON ml.level_id = m.level_id
WHERE tc.category_name = '物流延迟'
GROUP BY c.customer_state, ml.level_id, ml.level_name
ORDER BY ticket_count DESC, c.customer_state, ml.level_name
LIMIT 20;

afterSql:
SELECT tc.category_name,
       st.priority,
       COUNT(DISTINCT st.ticket_id) AS ticket_count,
       COUNT(tm.message_id) AS message_count
FROM support_tickets st
JOIN ticket_categories tc ON tc.category_id = st.category_id
LEFT JOIN ticket_messages tm ON tm.ticket_id = st.ticket_id
GROUP BY tc.category_name, st.priority
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.review_score <= 2) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS low_score_rate
FROM order_reviews r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
